scope: Bound allocations made while DRW_MLine::parseCode constructs DXF vertex and segment/fill parameter arrays and while pending parameter blocks are attached after the line count arrives.

behavior: The nine repeated vector-component groups use the exception-catching DRW::resize helper and increment their occurrence count only after the coordinate has been stored.

Group 74 pre-reserves bounded segment values and destination slots before publishing a parameter block. The line-known path computes candidate indices locally and rolls back any newly appended vertices if a later reservation fails.
Group 75 reserves the selected fill-value vector before changing the active parser state, so the same group can be retried after allocation failure.

Pending parameter attachment validates its bounded vertex count and target slots first, reserves every destination vector before moving any data, and removes newly grown vertices if reservation fails. Group 73 restores the prior line-count state after an attachment failure.

failureInjection.method: The focused test executable replaces global operator new with a scoped countdown fault injector and parses one DXF group at a time.
boundaries: All three pending group-73 attachment allocations
All four line-known group-74 setup allocations
failureInjection.result: Each injected allocation failure was observed exactly once, returned a parse failure without publishing partial logical state, and succeeded when the same group was retried. Completed parameter values were checked after attachment.
